subject: Exec approval: bridge package for quantization delay (Novaprod)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara@novaprod.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval: bridge package for quantization delay (Novaprod)

Sara / team —

Thanks again for the candid call yesterday. As discussed, our quantization roadmap slip (moving GA from early Nov to late Jan) will materially affect Novaprod's cost plan and go‑to‑market timing for the on‑device inference pilot. They asked for a commercial bridge while we finish the feature.

Proposal (ask to internal execs):
- Offer a 3‑month "Bridge Package": 40% discount on hosted tokens for pilot traffic (capped to $45k) + $25k one‑time usage credit applied to first invoice.
- Contract condition: Novaprod commits to a Dedicated pilot (reserved capacity) to start within 90 days of quantization GA.
- Timebox: offer valid for 30 days pending exec signoff.

Why this is reasonable:
- Prevents churn for a strategic pilot customer (Novaprod is a reference target in healthcare vertical).
- Limits long‑term revenue impact via explicit caps and a firm transition to Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: draft proposal, pricing sheet, and a mutual action plan.

Next steps I need from you:
- Laura: commercial approval to proceed with the bridge offer (I can then send to Sara).
- Michael: quick P&L impact estimate and suggested guardrails (we discussed a $45k cap but want your calc).
- Marissa: can you confirm the updated quantization ETA and whether any interim mitigations (reduced precision fallback) can be offered sooner?

Thanks — trying to get this to the customer by Friday.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: novaproposal_v1.pdf (proposal PDF, 48KB)]
[Attachment: pricing_spreadsheet.xlsx (workbook, 32KB)]
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.docx (docx, 24KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval: bridge package for quantization delay (Novaprod)

Karthik —

I support a bridge offer in principle for a strategic reference, but need a tighter set of conditions before giving final sign‑off:
- Shorter term cap (45k looks ok) but prefer a 60‑day vs 90‑day transition requirement to Dedicated.
- Must include a measurable deliverable: e.g., co‑branded case study commitment or in‑product testimonial before any extended discounts.
- Include clause: automatic reversion to standard pricing post bridge period; no retroactive credits.

Michael — pls run quick impact to ARR and margin, and suggest any additional guardrails (payment terms, minimum commitment).

Laura
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval: bridge package for quantization delay (Novaprod)

Quick finance read:
- If we accept 40% discount capped at $45k + $25k credit, nominal near‑term revenue hit is ~$70k, but gross margin impact is modest because token cost is low for the pilot scale.
- Risk to ARR: low if we tie to a Dedicated commitment with a minimum 6‑month reserved spend of $12k/mo.
- Recommend payment guardrails: 30% non‑refundable deposit, 60‑day cap to transition, and performance clause (case study or usage threshold).

If we tighten to 60 days and require deposit + minimal reserved spend, I can greenlight this under current sales budget without needing CFO sign‑off.

I'll attach the quick calc — see pricing_spreadsheet.xlsx.

—Michael
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval: bridge package for quantization delay (Novaprod)

Karthik / team —

Roadmap update and mitigation: quantization GA moved from 2026-11-05 to 2027-01-20 due to a third‑party kernel integration issue. Our mitigations:
- Short term: we can provide a reduced‑precision execution path (software fallback) for up to 30% throughput loss; will be available in ~3 weeks as a staged patch.
- Long term: GA remains 2027‑01‑20 with full perf; the patch reduces immediate customer disruption but does not match the cost profile of hardware quantization.

If the customer accepts the software fallback, we should be able to reduce the size of any commercial concession. However, customers with strict on‑device cost targets will still prefer hardware quantization.

Note: internal doc here — https://drive.redwood.com/drive/novaprod/roadmap-mitigation.

Marissa
VP Product, Serving Runtime

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara@novaprod.com>

Bcc:

Subject: Re: Exec approval: bridge package for quantization delay (Novaprod)

Sara —

Thanks for your patience while we finalized internal approvals. Summary of what we can offer today (approved by Sales + Finance + Product):

1) Bridge Package (approved terms):
- 40% discount on hosted tokens for up to 3 months, capped at $45,000 total usage discount.
- $25,000 one‑time credit applied to your first invoice.
- Customer commitment: move to Dedicated pilot within 60 days of quantization GA; 6‑month minimum reserved at $12k/mo.
- Payment: 30% non‑refundable deposit to activate the bridge package.
- Deliverable: co‑branded case study or product testimonial agreed by both parties.

2) Technical mitigation: Marissa's team can push a software fallback in ~3 weeks to reduce immediate impact; it's a stopgap and not equivalent to hardware quantization.

Attachments: formal proposal + MAP. If this looks good, please confirm by reply and we will raise a short order form.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Approved by Laura Bennett and Michael Grant)
